narrative_purpose: Atmospheric full-bleed background layer for the chapter page: a wide, dim open-ocean void that long-form reader prose floats over without competing with it.
subject: An ultra-wide panoramic view of vast open Pandoran ocean seen from high in the water column, looking outward into empty blue-black water. Faint broad shafts of pale light descend from a distant surface far above and dissolve before reaching the bottom of the frame. Very far below and to one side, the barest suggestion of a pale reef ridge fades into haze. Scattered drifting particles catch the light dimly. No single bright subject anywhere in the frame.
scene: Immense dim underwater emptiness receding into depth in every direction, all detail dissolving into atmospheric haze.
camera: High-vantage ultra-wide panorama with extreme atmospheric depth of field.
light: Very low contrast throughout, dim deep indigo ambient, weak diffuse light shafts from far above, faint scattered cyan glimmers in the distance.
palette: Void indigo and deep teal dominant, the faintest cyan glimmers, no warm accents.
style: Dark atmospheric background plate, painterly and diffuse, deliberately understated.
detail_level: Soft, hazy and low contrast everywhere so overlaid long-form text stays fully readable.
composition: Empty hazy open water filling the upper two thirds, the faint far reef ridge low in the lower third at one side, no focal subject.
consistency_notes: Must be dark, hazy and low contrast with no bright focal point anywhere, since long-form text is overlaid on top of it.
negative_prompt: no text, no labels, no bright foreground objects, no high-contrast elements, no creatures, no photographic or 3D-render look
